newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cementos Norte starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cementos Norte starts.

text.p: -- ING Barings said analysts Hector Castillo and Pablo Moreyra had started coverage of Peru's Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with a rating of buy.

-- "Since we are expecting a recovery in Cementos Norte Pacasmayo revenues and net profit for 1997 and 1998, we are initiating coverage ... with a buy recommendation as we consider that the company's fundamentals are very strong," they wrote in a Feb 17 report.
-- They set a 12-month price target of 6.05 soles, or $2.16. The company's shares were trading at 4.81 in Lima.
